common.provenance: All workload counts, native compute plans, logical-wave Ramulator2 timing, DRAMPower energy, V3.5 floorplan and HotSpot RC operator come from the audited current V3.5 experiment. The user-authorized capacity point is 32 GiB (16x2 GiB), with an explicit shared FP16 weight layout. No legacy result trace is consumed.

amber.paper: AMBER: Thermal-Aware Spatio-Temporal Scheduling for Edge LLM Inference on 3D DRAM-on-NPU Systems

offline_rc_objective.timing: full 16-request candidate event reschedule; latency/(baseline+latency) normalized to [0,1]

online_rc_controller.predictor: HotSpot-exported 1292-state RC backward Euler, two 0.5ms substeps

amber.comsol: NOT_RUN; common V3.5 HotSpot RC backend used for all methods
amber.parameter_provenance: MODELED controller/search hyperparameters because the paper does not publish an executable implementation or complete hyperparameters. No total-power scaling.

hiband.paper: HiBand: A Hierarchical Bandwidth-Aware HB-DRAM Accelerator with Array-Level Co-Execution and Reconfigurable NoC for LLM Inference
hiband.group_selection: Algorithm-1-style measured candidate sweep for each offered-load point
hiband.hic: Dependency-ready list scheduling of native NPUSim macro-wave shards through QKV/QK/PV; arrays are released at native service completion so independent compute can overlap the capacity-constrained physical XY collective; no whole-task division or max-stage latency formula and no work count is removed
hiband.sor: Dependency-ready extension of the native macro-wave shard pipeline through output/FFN phases; total parent MAC, native activity and semantic tensor bytes remain unchanged
hiband.weight_layout: Policy-specific shared checkpoint relayout with explicit primitive shard addresses over each selected GTP group; no per-request replication; each candidate must fit the same 16x2 GiB capacity
hiband.noc_adaptation: V3.5 fixed 4x4 XY physical links are unchanged. Each mode now changes the physical-link TDM reservation using its configured local/global share; reservations remain serialized and cannot exceed one flit/cycle. The paper's additional 2048-bit local-direct sub-link is not fabricated.
hiband.array_count_adaptation: Paper 32 arrays -> target 16 clusters. Only square groups that exactly tile the 4x4 target mesh (2x2 and 4x4) are legal.
hiband.parameter_provenance: Mechanism-equivalent event adaptation driven by current NPUSim macro waves and Ramulator2/DRAMPower profiles; not RTL reproduction of the paper's split-Benes router.
